$description: Token proposals for FileChip (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon covers it another way. Values are aliases to Carbon's own tokens where one exists.

background.$description: The chip's fill: one step lighter than the chat input it sits in. The input is white in light and the shell in dark (v12 $layer-03, #0c0d0f), so the chip is $layer-01 in light and $layer-02 in dark (v12 #f4f5f8 and #1e1f21). No single Carbon token is both. Falls back to $layer-01.

video-icon-size.$description: The video glyph on a thumbnail's 16px round $overlay backing. Carbon's icons start at 16, which fills the backing and reads too large on a 36px thumbnail; 12 is the $spacing-04 rung. The same in every theme. Falls back to $spacing-05 (16).
